answer: An agent economy can make each new key serve a paid probation. The entry ticket starts at 20 POA and doubles for every 50 keys admitted in one epoch, so a farm riding a tide of 500 sign-ups pays over 20,000 POA per key in its last batch. For 12 epochs its rewards stay escrowed while three graders not admitted alongside it re-run one of its past tasks with fresh inputs, like a garden irrigation plan or a jetty load estimate. One failed audit burns the escrow and the ticket. Limit: a patient farm can trickle keys in, but each still waits 12 epochs with nothing spendable.
